comment: Rewritten 2026-08-21 (Phase A3): the live tool is approval='auto' with a repeat-action guard {maxAutoCalls:1, windowDays:30} — NOT approval='required' as the original 2026-07-15 version assumed (the guard replaced it on 2026-07-21, and this scenario was silently red from that day until the CI-gate work caught it). What we assert now is the guard itself: the FIRST refund for a subscriber executes inline; the SECOND within the window flips auto -> approval and pauses. If the guard is ever removed or loosened, the second expect fails loudly rather than silently un-guarding repeat refunds — that is intentional.
description: Repeat-refund guard: first refund executes; a second refund for the same customer pauses for human approval instead of executing inline.
